note: Manual test cases drafted by Devin for JD-148 (Talos disputes suite migration). Xray is not installed on the Jira, so these are the drafts a human creates as Xray Test issues; the key is already referenced by the spec annotation and the legacy Talos tag is kept in talosTag for traceability.

tests.summary: Raise a dispute on a card transaction
tests.precondition: Persona demo.user is logged on and the Everyday Current Account statement contains a debit from Amazon
steps: Pick the reason "I did not make this purchase"
tests.expected: Message "Your dispute has been raised" is shown and the transaction shows the label "Disputed"
tests.spec: tests/disputes.spec.ts > Raise a dispute on a card transaction @smoke
tests.status: fixme: dispute screens not in the application

tests.precondition: Persona demo.user is logged on and the Everyday Current Account statement contains the credit "Salary"
tests.expected: The option "Dispute this transaction" is not available
tests.status: fixme: dispute screens not in the application

tests.precondition: Persona demo.user is logged on and the Everyday Current Account statement contains debits from <merchant>
steps: Confirm the dispute without picking a reason
tests.spec: tests/disputes.spec.ts > Reason is mandatory (Amazon) / Reason is mandatory (Tesco)
tests.status: fixme: dispute screens not in the application; Tesco is not in demo.user's Everyday Current Account seed
